r21c-002.gate_key: present_perfect_continuous | B1.2 | mcq | Choose the correct option: The children are washing their hands now. Look at the floor! They ___ with paint. | have been playing

item.q: Choose the correct option: The children are washing their hands now. Look at the floor! They ___ with paint.
item.why: They have stopped (they are washing their hands now), but the floor shows what they were doing: *They have been playing with paint.* *Are playing* would mean they are still playing.
item.why_lv: Viņi ir beiguši (tagad viņi mazgā rokas), bet grīda rāda, ko viņi darīja: *They have been playing with paint.* *Are playing* nozīmētu, ka viņi joprojām spēlējas.
